    19→use std::time::Duration;

    32→const DEFAULT_BASE_URL: &str = "https://api.spice.ai";
    33→const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
    34→
    35→/// HTTP client for the Spice Cloud API.
    36→pub struct CloudClient {
    37→    base_url: String,
    38→    client: Client,
    39→    token: Option<String>,
    40→}
    41→
    42→#[expect(
    43→    clippy::missing_errors_doc,
    44→    reason = "All public methods return Result with self-describing error types"
    45→)]
    46→impl CloudClient {
    47→    /// Create a new client with the given base URL.
    48→    ///
    49→    /// Use [`Self::with_token`] to set an authentication token, and
    50→    /// [`Self::with_timeout`] to override the default 30-second timeout.
    51→    pub fn new(base_url: &str) -> Result<Self> {
    52→        let client = Client::builder()
    53→            .timeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
    54→            .build()
    55→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
    56→
    57→        Ok(Self {
    58→            base_url: base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
    59→            client,
    60→            token: None,
    61→        })
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    /// Create a new client pointing at the default production API.
    65→    pub fn default_url() -> Result<Self> {
    66→        Self::new(DEFAULT_BASE_URL)
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    /// Set the bearer token used for authentication.
    70→    #[must_use]
    71→    pub fn with_token(mut self, token: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
    72→        self.token = Some(token.into());
    73→        self
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    /// Override the HTTP request timeout (default: 30 s).
    77→    ///
    78→    /// # Errors
    79→    ///
    80→    /// Returns an error if the HTTP client cannot be rebuilt with the given timeout.
    81→    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Self> {
    82→        self.client = Client::builder()
    83→            .timeout(timeout)
    84→            .build()
    85→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
    86→        Ok(self)
    87→    }
    88→
    89→    /// Return the configured base URL.
    90→    #[must_use]
    91→    pub fn base_url(&self) -> &str {
    92→        &self.base_url
    93→    }
    94→
    95→    // ========================================================================
    96→    // Auth
    97→    // ========================================================================
    98→
    99→    /// Build the browser auth URL for the device login flow.
   100→    #[must_use]
   101→    pub fn get_auth_url(&self, auth_code: &str) -> String {
   102→        format!(
   103→            "{}/v1/auth/device?code={}",
   104→            self.base_url.replace("api.", ""),
   105→            auth_code
   106→        )
   107→    }
   108→
   109→    /// Exchange a device auth code for an access token.
   110→    ///
   111→    /// Returns `Ok(None)` while the user has not yet completed the browser flow.
   112→    pub async fn exchange_code(&self, auth_code: &str) -> Result<Option<AuthExchangeResponse>> {
   113→        let url = format!(
   114→            "{}/v1/auth/device/exchange?code={}",
   115→            self.base_url, auth_code
   116→        );
   117→        let response = self
   118→            .client
   119→            .get(&url)
   120→            .send()
   121→            .await
   122→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
   123→
   124→        let status = response.status();
   125→        if status == reqwest::StatusCode::ACCEPTED {
   126→            return Ok(None);
   127→        }
   128→
   129→        if !status.is_success() {
   130→            self.handle_empty_response(response).await?;
   131→            return Err(error::Error::Api {
   132→                status: status.as_u16(),
   133→                message: "Unexpected non-success status while exchanging auth code".to_string(),
   134→            });
   135→        }
   136→
   137→        let body: AuthExchangeResponse = response.json().await.context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
   138→        Ok(Some(body))
   139→    }
   140→
   141→    /// Get the authentication context for the current token.
   142→    pub async fn get_auth_context(&self) -> Result<AuthContext> {
   143→        let url = format!("{}/v1/auth/context", self.base_url);
   144→        let response = self
   145→            .client
   146→            .get(&url)
   147→            .bearer_auth(self.token_str())
   148→            .send()
   149→            .await
   150→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
   151→
   152→        self.handle_response(response).await
   153→    }

   159→    /// List all apps visible to the current token.

   161→        let url = format!("{}/v1/apps", self.base_url);
   162→        let response = self
   163→            .client
   164→            .get(&url)

   166→            .send()
   167→            .await
   168→            .context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
   169→
   170→        let apps: AppsResponse = self.handle_response(response).await?;
   171→        Ok(apps.apps)
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    /// Get a single app by numeric ID.

   203→    /// Update an existing app.

   506→
   507→    async fn handle_response<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
   508→        &self,
   509→        response: reqwest::Response,
   510→    ) -> Result<T> {
   511→        let status = response.status();
   512→        let body = response.text().await.context(HttpRequestSnafu)?;
   513→        match status.as_u16() {
   514→            200..=202 => {
   515→                serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|source| error::Error::JsonParse { source })
   516→            }
   517→            401 => error::UnauthorizedSnafu {
   518→                message: body_or("invalid or expired token", &body),
   519→            }
   520→            .fail(),
   521→            403 => error::ForbiddenSnafu {
   522→                message: body_or("insufficient permissions", &body),
   523→            }
   524→            .fail(),
   525→            404 => error::NotFoundSnafu {
   526→                message: body_or("resource not found", &body),
   527→            }
   528→            .fail(),
   529→            409 => error::ConflictSnafu {
   530→                message: body_or("conflict", &body),
   531→            }
   532→            .fail(),
   533→            _ => error::ApiSnafu {
   534→                status: status.as_u16(),
   535→                message: body,
   536→            }
   537→            .fail(),
   538→        }
   539→    }

   548→                message: body_or("invalid or expired token", &body),
   549→            }
   550→            .fail(),
   551→            403 => error::ForbiddenSnafu {
   552→                message: body_or("insufficient permissions", &body),
   553→            }
   554→            .fail(),
   555→            404 => error::NotFoundSnafu {

   557→            }
   558→            .fail(),
   559→            409 => error::ConflictSnafu {

   562→            .fail(),
   563→            _ => error::ApiSnafu {
   564→                status: status.as_u16(),

   576→fn body_or<'a>(fallback: &'a str, body: &'a str) -> &'a str {

   580→        body

- Added `IngestionMetrics` struct with `rows_ingested: Option<u64>` and `bytes_ingested: Option<u64>`

- `execute_metrics` now prints an "Ingestion" section after the pod metrics table when ingestion data is present
